description: This file defines an API service module for the frontend web application, providing functions to simulate operations such as sending OTP, verifying OTP, registering tourists, renewing registrations, and fetching incident data. It uses uuid for unique IDs and interacts with external types, notably 'Incident'.

methods.name: sendOTP
methods.description: Simulates sending an OTP via email or phone, always succeeds and generates a random 6-digit OTP.

methods.name: verifyOTP
methods.description: Verifies the input OTP against an expected value.

methods.name: registerTourist
methods.description: Simulates tourist registration, generating unique IDs and a transaction hash.

methods.name: renewTourist
methods.description: Simulates renewing a tourist registration, extending validity by 6 months.

methods.name: fetchIncidents
methods.description: Fetches a list of incident objects, each representing a different incident scenario.
